author: Scott Manley
description:
Finally back from my long trip and with a lot of new news to talk about, including the entire flight of Artemis II, I was there at the launch and I watched the landing live. I'm so delighted to see people paying attention to this flight around the moon!

China also debuted two new rockets, one successful, the other not. Kinetica 2 is a huge upgrade from Kinetica 1, and Tianlong-3 is similarly large, both are supposed to be comparable to Falcon 9 in terms of launch capability and both have aspirations to recover booster stages.
